metadata.question: Is the forest loss from 2015 to 2022 larger than that from 2000 to 2015 at Macaya National Park?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Hansen Global Forest Change dataset which has forest loss by year - Location: Macaya National Park in Haiti - Compare forest loss in two periods: 2000-2015 vs 2015-2022 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed (Hansen is annual composite) - Use loss year band to filter specific time periods - Mask to only areas that had tree cover in 2000 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid Zero (B): One or both periods legitimately had zero forest loss - C1: Dataset issues (unlikely with Hansen) - C2: No valid pixels after masking (e.g., no forest cover to begin with) - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Compare loss areas: if 2015-2022 > 2000-2015, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Macaya National Park geometry (Haiti) const macayaPark = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-74.05, 18.32], [-74.05, 18.42], [-73.95, 18.42], [-73.95, 18.32], [-74.05, 18.32]] ]); // 2. Load Hansen Global Forest Change dataset const hansen = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2023_v1_11'); // Get relevant bands const treecover2000 = hansen.select('treecover2000'); const lossYear = hansen.select('lossyear'); // 3. Mask to areas with tree cover in 2000 (>10% threshold) const forestMask = treecover2000.gt(10); // 4. Calculate forest loss for period 2000-2015 (loss years 1-15) const loss2000_2015 = lossYear.gte(1).and(lossYear.lte(15)).and(forestMask); // 5. Calculate forest loss for period 2015-2022 (loss years 16-22) const loss2015_2022 = lossYear.gte(16).and(lossYear.lte(22)).and(forestMask); // 6. Count pixels with forest cover to check for C2 const forestCount = forestMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: macayaPark, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('treecover2000'); const forestPixels = await forestCount.getInfo(); if (forestPixels === null || forestPixels === 0) { console.log('No forest pixels found in 2000.'); console.log('C2'); return; } console.log(`Forest pixels in 2000: ${Math.round(forestPixels)}`); // 7. Calculate loss area for both periods const loss1Stats = await loss2000_2015.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: macayaPark, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lossyear').getInfo(); const loss2Stats = await loss2015_2022.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: macayaPark, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('lossyear').getInfo(); // 8. Validate results if (loss1Stats === null || loss2Stats === null) { console.log('Calculation failed to return valid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const loss2000_2015_pixels = loss1Stats; const loss2015_2022_pixels = loss2Stats; // Convert pixels to hectares (30m resolution = 900 m²/pixel) const loss2000_2015_ha = (loss2000_2015_pixels * 900) / 10000; const loss2015_2022_ha = (loss2015_2022_pixels * 900) / 10000; console.log(`Forest loss 2000-2015: ${loss2000_2015_ha.toFixed(2)} ha (${loss2000_2015_pixels} pixels)`); console.log(`Forest loss 2015-2022: ${loss2015_2022_ha.toFixed(2)} ha (${loss2015_2022_pixels} pixels)`); // 9. Compare and provide answer if (loss2015_2022_pixels > loss2000_2015_pixels) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
